other_conditions: The applicant must have completed at least 90 days of building and other construction work in the last 12 months.
The applicant’s registration must be renewed annually.
The applicant must be engaged in building or construction work under the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB).
The applicant must be registered with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB).
The applicant’s membership with the Board must be active at the time of application.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,50,000 for house construction under the scheme.
